description: Formula models (docs/implementation/formula_models.md): definitions read from the metadata, the parameter normalization, and the runs of instances. Charts: 4 candles of 15 minutes from the time 0, CLOSE = [1, 2, 3, 4].

cases.description: An indicator definition with parameters and outputs
formula: parameters: { width: { type: "Number", default: 1, min: 0 }, side: { type: "Text", default: "both", options: ["both", "upper"] } },
stock: { category: "Volatility", outputs: { upper: { name: "Upper" }, lower: { } } }
{ upper: CLOSE[I] + PARAMETERS.width, lower: CLOSE[I] - PARAMETERS.width }

cases.description: The name is the identifier when it is not given
A strategy definition with the labels of its checks
formula: <@ { id: "s", context: "Stock.Strategy", stock: { checks: { up: "Bullish candle", rising: "Rising close" } } } @>

cases.description: A formula without metadata is not a definition
A context that is not an indicator, a pattern or a strategy
An identifier that is not valid
A value of a wrong type in a known key
A metadata block that is not valid
Missing parameters get their defaults, in the order of the specifications
formula: <@ { id: "x", context: "Stock.Indicator", parameters: { a: { type: "Number", default: 1 }, b: { type: "Text", default: "t" } } } @>

cases.description: A parameter without a type accepts any value, also null
Every problem is reported, unknown keys first
formula: <@ { id: "x", context: "Stock.Indicator", parameters: { n: { type: "Number", min: 1, max: 10 }, m: { type: "Number", default: 5, max: 3 }, t: { type: "Number", default: 1 }, o: { default: "a", options: ["a", "b"] } } } @>

cases.description: A value lower than the lowest allowed one
formula: <@ { id: "x", context: "Stock.Indicator", parameters: { period: { type: "Number", default: 14, min: 1 } } } @>

cases.description: Options are compared by value, also Arrays
formula: <@ { id: "x", context: "Stock.Indicator", parameters: { levels: { type: "Array", default: [30, 70], options: [[30, 70], [20, 80]] } } } @>

cases.description: The outputs of an indicator with Object results
formula: <@ { id: "band", context: "Stock.Indicator", parameters: { width: { type: "Number", default: 1 } }, stock: { outputs: { lower: { }, upper: { } } } } @>
IF(I == 0, null, { upper: CLOSE[I] + PARAMETERS.width, lower: CLOSE[I] - PARAMETERS.width, mid: CLOSE[I] })

cases.description: A Number result is the output value
Without results other than null, the outputs are those of the definition
The signals of a strategy: Numbers and signal objects, clamped, NEUTRAL skipped
formula: <@ { id: "s", context: "Stock.Strategy", parameters: { limit: { type: "Number", default: 3 } } } @>
IF(I == 0, NEUTRAL, IF(I == 1, 2, { signal: IF(CLOSE[I] > PARAMETERS.limit, SELL, 0.5), reason: "r", checks: { high: CLOSE[I] > PARAMETERS.limit }, stop: LOW[I] }))
